context.guidance: Serve every route that carries Personal Data over TLS only, and set Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite attributes on session cookies. Replace wildcard cross-origin rules with an explicit list of trusted origins. These transport and session controls are part of the safeguards Rule 6(1)(a) requires for the Personal Data they carry.

value.fix: Set secure attributes when issuing the session cookie: res.cookie('token', updatedToken, { httpOnly: true, secure: true, sameSite: 'strict', path: '/', maxAge: <session lifetime in ms> }). With httpOnly, client-side scripts can't read the token, which limits theft through XSS. With secure, the cookie is only sent over HTTPS. sameSite set to 'strict' (or 'lax' if cross-site top-level navigation must keep the session) blocks CSRF. Set the same options everywhere the token cookie is set or cleared, for example res.clearCookie('token', { httpOnly: true, secure: true, sameSite: 'strict', path: '/' }). Serve every route that handles this cookie or Personal Data over TLS only: redirect HTTP to HTTPS, add HSTS (for example helmet.hsts), and call app.set('trust proxy', 1) if the app runs behind a TLS-terminating proxy so Express treats requests as secure. Also replace any wildcard CORS setting such as origin: '*' with an explicit allowlist of trusted origins, used together with credentials: true. These controls cover the safeguards Rule 6(1)(a) requires.
